summary: The r450k marketing site's Downloads page linked each release asset with `target="_blank"`, which opened a new blank tab and silently dropped the download instead of downloading the file — the Cloudflare Worker `/api/download` proxy behind it was already correct. Links now use a same-tab `download` attribute so clicking an asset downloads it in place, matching normal browser download behavior.
compatibility: Frontend-only fix on the r450k static site; no backend/Worker change, no impact on the Go apps or their versioned releases.
